login.title: Sign in
login.remember: Trust this device for 24 hours (skip the code)
login.biometricFailed: Biometric sign-in failed or is not enabled on this device. Use your password instead.
login.badCode: Invalid or already used code — wait for the next one
login.rateLimited: Too many failed attempts — wait a few minutes

device.pendingBody: Your credentials are valid, but this device has not been approved yet. A superadmin must authorize it (CLI or devices panel).
device.identityBody: Give this identifier to a superadmin so they can pre-authorize this browser, or read them the fingerprint shown after you sign in. Once the browser is approved, any admin may sign in from it.
device.fingerprintHint: Read this code to the superadmin so they can confirm it matches the request.
device.cliHint: Server-side command: docker compose exec api adminng.py --approve-device {{id}}
device.revoked: This device was revoked. Ask a superadmin to approve it again.

enroll.title: Set up two-factor authentication
enroll.body: Superadmins must enroll an authenticator. Scan the QR or enter the secret, then confirm with a code.

privacy.title: Session locked
privacy.body: Enter your password to unlock the session.

offline: No connection to the server. Write operations are blocked for safety.

server.title: Server address
server.body: This build is not tied to a server yet. Enter the base URL of your MailD AdminNG installation (the address you also open in a browser).
server.warning: Changing the server signs you out and clears this device's local data.

domains.title: Domains
domains.noAliases: No domain aliases are linked to this domain.
domains.advisory: Restart amavis, mua and mta to generate DKIM keys, webmail config and aliases for the new domain.

mailboxes.title: Accounts
mailboxes.aliasForwardsHelp: One per line, or comma / space separated — fan-out is supported.

confirm.title: Security confirmation
confirm.body: This action is permanent. Re-authenticate to continue.

settings.biometricUnavailable: Biometric sign-in is not configured by the server administrator.
settings.biometricEnabled: A platform credential is enabled for this device.
settings.biometricDisabled: No biometric credential is registered for this device.
settings.biometricPassword: Administrator password to enable or disable
settings.biometricFailure: The biometric operation could not be completed.

biometricPrompt.title: Sign in faster next time
biometricPrompt.body: Enable biometric sign-in on this device. After that, you can sign in with your fingerprint or face instead of typing your password.
